_comment: Chroma1-HD text-to-image. Chosen over SDXL because it was retrained from FLUX.1-schnell with the anatomical concepts the safety-filtered models are missing — the failure that had SDXL stretching a penis to the floor and omitting testicles is a missing prior, and no prompt fixes that. Apache 2.0, so it is usable commercially. Structure follows ComfyUI's Chroma workflow: T5 only, no CLIP, and the encoder is loaded with type 'chroma'. Real CFG applies here (unlike the distilled schnell it came from), so the negative prompt does work. Placeholders: __POSITIVE__, __NEGATIVE__. __CKPT__ is accepted and ignored — the graph names its own weights. Node 10 loads the anatomy LoRA trained on this same base: even Chroma's prior for an erection is unreliable — plain wording produced a downward-hanging one about six times in ten, and no weighting reached the rest — so the form is carried by trained weights instead. It only fires when its trigger word is in the prompt, which the API prepends.
